offers_products.reason: Sells insurance coverage, a financial service, not goods or software.

offers_services.reason: Writes commercial residential property insurance for condo, HOA, apartment and assisted living properties in Florida.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Covers condo associations, HOAs, apartments and assisted living facilities, placed via agents and MGAs, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Policyholders are condo associations, HOAs, apartment owners and assisted living operators, placed through brokers.

recurring_revenue.reason: Insurance policies renew annually, giving ongoing premium revenue from the same property clients.

cyclical_demand.reason: Property insurance is required by lenders and associations, so customers can't easily cut it in a downturn.

big_ticket.reason: Annual insurance premiums are recurring, routine purchases, not large infrequent ones.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for risk-bearing capital and reinsurance backing, not staff time; MGAs handle distribution.

large_customers.reason: Customers are mostly condo and HOA associations and apartment owners, typically small organizations, not large enterprises.

asset_heavy.reason: Insurance carrier relying on reinsurance and capital, with no plants, fleets or networks to build.

notes: Insurance carrier; large_customers is a judgment call because association and apartment owners vary in size.
